title: Becker AR6201 VHF Transceiver (Official MSFS / Asobo)
company: FlightSim Studio AG (Contracted to Asobo Studio)
summary: Engineered the authentic Becker Avionics AR6201 compact VHF aviation transceiver under contract from Asobo Studio for integration into official default aircraft in Microsoft Flight Simulator.
highlights: Faithfully simulated the certified Becker AR6201 8.33 kHz / 25 kHz VHF communications transceiver.
Engineered active/standby frequency exchange, dual concentric rotary tuning, memory channels, and squelch control.
Integrated power supply voltage monitoring, inter-communication (IC) modes, and MSFS SimVar two-way binding.
